inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Some re-training on previously studied topics is necessary to keep skills and knowledge up-to-date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The vehicle used for transportation was missing a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Three of the four files reviewed for the caregivers and the director were missing proof of training in pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility: The vehicle used for transportation was missing information about the operation's name and telephone number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The vehicle used for transportation was missing a first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: Portions of the fence for the outdoor playground were under four feet in height.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have documentation showing that a fire inspection has been conducted within the past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three of the four files reviewed for the caregivers and the director were missing proof of training in pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: At the time of inspection one child did not have their required vision and hearing screening on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's immunization record had been written in by their parent, but not signed and verified by a medical professional, which is required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation's last documented fire drill was on 4/25/25. There was no documentation available to indicate that a fire drill was conducted in the month of May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - License: At the time of inspection the operation did not have the required postings present and/or posted in a prominent area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - License (26 TAC §746.401(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity: At the time of inspection, the operation was over its maximum capacity of 24 children. There was a total of 26 children in care during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: At the time of inspection, the staff did not have all of their record documents on file for review. This included copy of their photo ID, personnel information form, background check confirmation pages, qualification documents, job description, and training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection time the outdoors play area fence was not in good repair. The wire from the the fence had been lifted and one of the exit gates had nails exposed and was closed by a charging cable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kits present in the building did not have tweezers, anti-septic wipes or solution, disposable gloves, or a thermometer present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The vehicle utilized to transport children enrolled into care did not have a fire extinguisher or emergency information for each child transported present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last documented fire drill was conducted in 9/24. No documentation is available to indicate that a fire drill was conducted in October or November of this month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The last severe weather and lock down drill was back in 4/2024. No documentation is available for any follow up drills at this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: At the time of inspection the mounted fire extinguisher did not have a tag present to indicate that it had been serviced within this past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation's last documented fire inspection by the local fire marshal was in 10/2023. No follow up fire inspection as been conducted by the time of this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: In addition to the standards evaluated for this monitoring inspection, this standard was found to be deficient. During the inspection, the height of the fence was 3 feet 5 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening: The operational policies were missing information regarding hearing and vision requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.501(a)(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: The operational policies were missing information regarding  preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Immunizations: The operational policies were missing information regarding immunization requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.501(a)(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Two of the four children records reviewed were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: The operation did not have their emergency evacuation maps posted in each room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One of the two personnel records reviewed was missing a notarized Licensing Affidavit for Applicants for Employment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have  proof of a gas leak test.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5405)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The operation has not yet completed their fenced outdoor space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies were missing a statement regarding the promotion of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The operational policies were missing information about how the operation supports inclusive services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline: The operational policies were missing information about how to contact the local licensing office and the Texas Abuse and Neglect hotline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules: The operational policies were missing the procedures for how parents can review licensing reports and access licensing rules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules (26 TAC §746.501(a)(22))
